name: Aera Video Player
summary:
Watch video on a screen that floats freely in front of you — not pinned to your head, not a room around you. Place it anywhere in VR space, reach in and move it, then take your headset off.

  Flat video
  H.264, H.265 and VP9 through the headset's hardware decoder. Play from local storage or any WebDAV server, and browse folders without leaving VR.

  Panorama and 3D
  180° and 360° footage, side-by-side / over-under / half-SBS stereo, and fisheye input shown flat or mapped onto a sphere with a 180–220°
